Toss the onion with minced garlic, oil, salt and pepper.
Spread on a baking tray and roast 30 to 40 minutes, turning once, until golden and cooked through.

name: Mushroom Tacos
steps: Season and cook the mushroom in a hot pan until done.
Warm the tortillas.
Fill with the filling, chopped onion, tomato, lettuce and cheese.

name: Garlic Sauteed Bell Pepper
steps: Heat oil and sauté the garlic and onion until fragrant.
Add the bell pepper and cook, stirring, until just tender.
Season with salt and pepper.

name: Beef and Bell Pepper Stir-Fry
steps: Slice the beef and bell pepper into bite-size pieces.
Stir-fry the garlic and beef in hot oil until cooked through.
Add the bell pepper and oyster sauce and cook 4 minutes more. Serve with rice.

name: Creamy Bacon Spaghetti
steps: Boil the pasta in salted water until al dente and save a cup of the water.
Cook the bacon with garlic, pour in the cream and simmer, then melt in the cheese.
Toss the pasta through the sauce, loosening with pasta water. Season and serve.

name: Fish and Tomato Soup
steps: Heat oil in a pot and sauté the onion and ginger for 3 minutes.
Add the fish, tomato and 4 cups of water. Simmer until everything is tender.
Season with salt and pepper and serve hot.

name: Corn and Bell Pepper Omelette
steps: Chop the corn and bell pepper small and soften them in oil for 2 minutes.
Pour in the beaten eggs and cook until nearly set.
Fold the omelette in half and serve.

name: Bell Pepper and Cucumber Salad
steps: Wash and cut the bell pepper and cucumber into bite-size pieces.
Whisk lemon juice, oil, salt and pepper into a dressing.
Toss everything together and chill 10 minutes before serving.
